title: Inside the Piano Lid  (Bajo la tapa del piano)

segments.t: Hannah llama a la señorita Evelyn a la galería recién iluminada, donde Caleb señala la esquina de un pliego color crema encajado detrás del atril de madera del piano. Escucha primero toda la escena.
You fixed the ceiling lamp! The walnut wood shines like honey now!
Look right here behind the folding music desk when the lamp shines down.
Is that folded music paper stuck inside the hinge?
Let me slide it out gently with two fingers so the paper does not tear.
Handwritten notes in black ink! Can you read the title on top, Evelyn?
'Courtyard Waltz — for Friday Evening Tea, May, thirty years ago.'
That matches the exact date on the postcard in the cedar box!
Let me hum the opening bar... oh, what a gentle, singing melody!
Wait, turn the sheet over! Half of page two is blank!
The composer wrote twenty-four bars and stopped right in the middle of a phrase!
And look at the penciled note at the bottom: 'Finish before Friday.'
Why did the music stop thirty years ago, and who wrote it?!
Recorramos ahora cada línea del hallazgo.
You fixed the ceiling lamp! The walnut wood shines like honey now!
'¡Arreglaron la lámpara de techo! ¡La madera de nogal brilla como la miel ahora!'
Look right here behind the folding music desk when the lamp shines down.
'Miren justo aquí detrás del atril plegable cuando la lámpara alumbra hacia abajo.'
Is that folded music paper stuck inside the hinge?
'¿Está ese papel pautado doblado atascado dentro de la bisagra?'
Let me slide it out gently with two fingers so the paper does not tear.
'Déjenme deslizarlo hacia fuera con cuidado con dos dedos para que el papel no se rasgue.'
Handwritten notes in black ink! Can you read the title on top, Evelyn?
'¡Notas escritas a mano en tinta negra! ¿Puedes leer el título de arriba, Evelyn?'
'Courtyard Waltz — for Friday Evening Tea, May, thirty years ago.'
'"Vals del patio — para el té del viernes por la tarde, mayo, hace treinta años."'
That matches the exact date on the postcard in the cedar box!
'¡Eso coincide con la fecha exacta de la postal en la caja de cedro!'
Let me hum the opening bar... oh, what a gentle, singing melody!
'Déjenme tararear el compás inicial... ¡oh, qué melodía tan suave y cantarina!'
Wait, turn the sheet over! Half of page two is blank!
'¡Esperen, denle la vuelta a la hoja! ¡La mitad de la página dos está en blanco!'
The composer wrote twenty-four bars and stopped right in the middle of a phrase!
'¡Quien la compuso escribió veinticuatro compases y se detuvo justo en mitad de una frase!'
And look at the penciled note at the bottom: 'Finish before Friday.'
'Y miren la nota a lápiz en la parte de abajo: "Terminar antes del viernes."'
Why did the music stop thirty years ago, and who wrote it?!
'¿¡Por qué se detuvo la música hace treinta años y quién la escribió!?'
Escuchemos de nuevo toda la escena seguida.
You fixed the ceiling lamp! The walnut wood shines like honey now!
Look right here behind the folding music desk when the lamp shines down.
Is that folded music paper stuck inside the hinge?
Let me slide it out gently with two fingers so the paper does not tear.
Handwritten notes in black ink! Can you read the title on top, Evelyn?
'Courtyard Waltz — for Friday Evening Tea, May, thirty years ago.'
That matches the exact date on the postcard in the cedar box!
Let me hum the opening bar... oh, what a gentle, singing melody!
Wait, turn the sheet over! Half of page two is blank!
The composer wrote twenty-four bars and stopped right in the middle of a phrase!
And look at the penciled note at the bottom: 'Finish before Friday.'
Why did the music stop thirty years ago, and who wrote it?!
Escondido en el corazón del piano dormía un 'Vals del patio' manuscrito e inacabado de hace treinta años. Nos queda una última escena para cerrar este segundo episodio.
Goodbye!
